title: KV cache + attention kernel + seq length debug notes
body:
Goal: track down a recurring regression where long-context requests (>=12k tokens) either show huge latency spikes or return garbled completions. Suspect interplay between KV cache lifetime, attention kernel selection heuristics, and an off-by-one in sequence-length bucketing.

Summary of behaviour observed:
- Problem reproducible with open-model-v2 (decoder only, 16k max) on p4d instance.
- When request seq_len ~12000, initial tokens stream fine, then around token ~12240 server stalls for 1500-3000ms, then resumes but with strange token duplication or context loss.
- Not seen for seq_len <8k. Intermittent for 8k-12k.

What I tried (commands + outputs):
1) Local repro (server-local) with synthetic prompt (repeat A * 12000):
   ./run_infer.sh --model open-model-v2 --input-file tests/long_prompt.txt --max-tokens 1024 --device cuda:0  
   -> logs: served batch id=1123 seq_len=12244 kernel=attn_fused_v2 kv_cache_mode=auto
   -> stderr snippet: WARNING: kv_cache: eviction threshold crossed (policy=auto, free_slots=8)
   -> result: duplicated phrases after stall

2) Force kernel to legacy (no fused):
   ./run_infer.sh --model open-model-v2 --kernel legacy_attn --input-file tests/long_prompt.txt
   -> logs: kernel=legacy_attn seq_len=12244 kv_cache_mode=auto
   -> result: much longer latency but no token duplication; suggests kernel-specific bug

3) Disable KV cache completely:
   ./run_infer.sh --model open-model-v2 --kv-cache=disabled --input-file tests/long_prompt.txt
   -> result: performance drops but no duplication/stall. Latency consistent ~1.8x baseline.

4) Reproduce on dedicated-staging (p4d cluster) using canary build with added debug prints:
   Observed: cache eviction log emitted exactly when stall happens. Eviction log lines: "evicting kv slab id=7 start_idx=8192 end_idx=12288" then immediately "kv_fetch_miss for seq_offset=12240".

Hypotheses:
- H1: Kernel swap race: when kernel selection switches to optimized fused attention for large seq_len, it expects contiguous KV layout; eviction during/after the swap leaves pointers stale -> duplication.
- H2: Off-by-one in sequence bucketing: eviction uses exclusive end but kernel uses inclusive boundaries causing last token to be fetched twice or skipped.
- H3: KV cache compaction path has a bug for slabs that cross 8k boundaries (internal slab size=4096?).

Quick checks to run next:
- Add strong assertions around KV pointers before/after kernel selection (addresses + generation id). If assertion triggers, capture full slab map.
- Re-run canary forcing kernel to fused_v2 but disable eviction for the relevant slab range (introduce config kv.eviction_disabled_until_seq=14000) to see if stall disappears.
- Add sequence length unit test that simulates slab boundary crossing (create fake KV with end_idx exactly at 12288).
- Binary search which slab size triggers issue: 2048, 4096, 8192.

Notes about implementation points I checked:
- Kernel selection: serving_runtime/kernel_selector.cc picks kernel by max(seq_len, kv_span) and hardware capability. There is a fallback path that does a memcpy-based layout conversion if current KV layout != expected.
- KV manager: kv_cache_manager.cpp uses slab_size constant 4096 for now (TODO: make configurable). eviction policy is LRU with generation counter.
- I saw one odd code path in kv_compact() where it sets target_end = slab_end - 1 when compacting last slab. That seems like a potential off-by-one.

Logs to attach to ticket: (copied snippets)
- "evicting kv slab id=7 start_idx=8192 end_idx=12288"
- "kv_fetch_miss for seq_offset=12240 slab_id=7"
- "kernel selected: attn_fused_v2 (requires contiguous=true)"
- "memcpy layout convert: src_stride=256 dest_stride=256 length=12288"

Immediate mitigation ideas for Prod:
- Pin kernel selection to legacy_attn for requests with seq_len > 10k until root cause fixed. (Config flag: runtime.kernel_policy.pin_large_seq=legacy_attn)
- Increase eviction buffer so we avoid compacting slabs until seq_offset > max_seen + 8192. (kv.eviction_guard=8192)

Action items (who/when):
- Jordan: add assert + logging in kv_fetch() to capture pointer gen ids (today)
- Priya: try canary with eviction disabled for slabs crossing 8k boundary (tomorrow)
- Liam: prepare rollback toggle to pin legacy kernel in prod (ASAP)

Unresolved questions:
- Is slab_size always 4096 in all deployments? If not, need to correlate erring instances.
- Does this affect encoder-decoder models that shard KV differently? Quick check: ran test on t5-like checkpoint (encoder-decoder) -> no repro so far.

Notes to self: keep this as a short-lived scratchpad. If we confirm H1 or H2, file a PR with tests in serving-runtime/unit/kv_tests and add flag to kernel_selector to double-check contiguous property before swap.

Related tickets: INF-987 (tracking), GH #5123 (WIP PR for kernel pin), TODO: follow up with ops to get flame graphs for the stall periods.
